purpose: Paraphrase-only fixtures for testing PR36 risk-mode review and reliance policy before runtime enforcement or judges.

fixtures.domain_or_context: ordinary strategic decision with clean saved artifacts
fixtures.artifact_condition: required saved product and custody artifacts are present and product-clean
fixtures.answer_level_expected: answer can pass or fail on answer merits; not_checked is not an answer-level failure by default
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: inspect_first or warn for live-output caveat while saved artifacts remain reviewable
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review unless a human reviewer explicitly labels yes
fixtures.caller_action_expected: existing policy only; clean standard run may be use_revised_answer, but that is not human approval
fixtures.human_review_requirement: answer-level review may proceed; note live-output caveat
fixtures.invalid_behavior: treating clean saved artifacts plus not_checked live output as automatic safe_for_agent_use yes
fixtures.why: PR35 separates saved answer review from live-output proof, and PR36 keeps reliance human-owned.

fixtures.domain_or_context: ordinary strategic decision with complete trusted live transcript
fixtures.artifact_condition: required saved product and custody artifacts are present and product-clean
fixtures.live_output_condition: trusted live transcript is complete, synchronized, and scanned clean
fixtures.answer_level_expected: answer can pass or fail on answer merits
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: live-output caveat can clear if all other deterministic checks pass
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: still a human label; no automatic human approval
fixtures.caller_action_expected: existing policy only; live-output cleanliness does not relax caller_action
fixtures.human_review_requirement: human review may rely on cleaner custody surface but must still judge answer/reliance separately
fixtures.invalid_behavior: using trusted live-output cleanliness as a substitute for answer-level review or human approval
fixtures.why: PR35 allows a bounded path to live_output_health clean but rejects caller-action relaxation.

fixtures.domain_or_context: high-consequence business, employment, clinical, legal, financial, safety, or family-adjacent decision
fixtures.artifact_condition: required saved product and custody artifacts are present and product-clean
fixtures.answer_level_expected: answer can pass if it adds real action, evidence, threshold, stop-rule, or expert-question improvements
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: inspect_first for reliance because high stakes plus unproven live output is not a clean product-surface example
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review or no; never automatic yes
fixtures.caller_action_expected: conservative stance; current contract uses ask_user_first for otherwise clean high_stakes runs
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required when the decision depends on domain-specific correctness
fixtures.invalid_behavior: letting clean saved artifacts override high-stakes reliance requirements
fixtures.why: PR36 says risk mode raises reliance burden and does not approve action.

fixtures.domain_or_context: high-stakes decision with trusted clean live-output evidence
fixtures.artifact_condition: required saved product and custody artifacts are present and product-clean
fixtures.live_output_condition: trusted live transcript is complete, synchronized, and scanned clean
fixtures.answer_level_expected: answer can pass if it improves action quality and preserves appropriate uncertainty
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: live-output caveat can clear, but risk-sensitive reliance remains inspect_first
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review or no unless explicit human/domain ratification supports a narrower yes
fixtures.caller_action_expected: conservative stance remains; current high_stakes behavior is ask_user_first, not automatic use
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required when domain correctness is material
fixtures.invalid_behavior: treating live-output cleanliness as domain approval
fixtures.why: PR35 clears only live-output proof; PR36 keeps high-stakes reliance separate from answer quality and domain authority.

fixtures.domain_or_context: high-stakes decision with missing, degraded, or unsafe custody artifacts
fixtures.artifact_condition: capture critical, required artifact missing, product output unsafe, provider-boundary contamination, or similar degradation
fixtures.live_output_condition: any live-output state; live cleanliness does not rescue degraded saved artifacts
fixtures.answer_level_expected: answer may contain useful ideas but should not be treated as reliance-ready
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: degraded for reliance; require rerun, backfill where legitimate, or explicit review
fixtures.caller_action_expected: do_not_use_run_degraded or equivalent existing conservative policy
fixtures.human_review_requirement: required to decide whether any limited learning can be salvaged
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required before real-world action if domain correctness matters
fixtures.invalid_behavior: using clean live output or fluent prose to rescue degraded saved custody
fixtures.why: PR35 and PR36 both preserve custody failures as reliance blockers.

fixtures.domain_or_context: high-stakes run where the revised answer introduces unsupported domain-specific legal, clinical, financial, safety, or crisis detail
fixtures.artifact_condition: artifacts may be present and product-clean, but answer content contains unsupported new domain claim
fixtures.live_output_condition: not material to primary failure unless also unsafe
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: custody may be clean while answer-level review fails or requires follow-up
fixtures.caller_action_expected: conservative stance; unsupported_high_stakes_domain is the relevant enum if future policy selects it, but PR37 does not implement selection
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required before relying on the claim
fixtures.invalid_behavior: preferring fluent unsupported domain detail because it sounds decisive
fixtures.why: High-stakes mode is stricter reasoning hygiene, not domain assurance.

fixtures.domain_or_context: high-stakes decision where user values, stakeholder obligations, or non-negotiables conflict and the conflict is unresolved
fixtures.artifact_condition: required saved product and custody artifacts are present and product-clean
fixtures.live_output_condition: live_output_health may be not_checked or clean, but live-output state does not resolve the value conflict
fixtures.answer_level_expected: answer can pass only if it surfaces the conflict, avoids ranking values automatically, and asks the human or domain reviewer to resolve the tradeoff before action
fixtures.primary_failure_mode_expected: missing_friction if the conflict is omitted; none if the conflict is surfaced and bounded
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: custody can be clean while reliance remains conservative because the unresolved value conflict is an answer/reliance issue
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review or no; never automatic yes
fixtures.caller_action_expected: conservative stance; otherwise clean high_stakes remains ask_user_first under the current contract
fixtures.human_review_requirement: required to decide whether the answer preserved and bounded the conflict
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required when the conflict turns on domain-specific consequences
fixtures.invalid_behavior: treating an inferred value as user approval, resolving the conflict automatically, or letting clean custody override the unresolved tradeoff
fixtures.why: PR34 makes values/priorities audit context, and PR36 says risk mode raises reliance burden without approving action.

fixtures.domain_or_context: standard run where saved revised answer and memo are clean but live narration leaks machinery language
fixtures.artifact_condition: saved product artifacts are present and clean
fixtures.live_output_condition: live transcript leaks machinery or internal process language
fixtures.answer_level_expected: may pass for saved artifacts if the saved answer is otherwise good
fixtures.primary_failure_mode_expected: none for saved-answer review; private_public_leak for live-output surface review
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: live-output hygiene fails or warns; not a clean product-surface example
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review or no depending severity and review surface
fixtures.caller_action_expected: do not relax; live-output issue keeps reliance conservative
fixtures.human_review_requirement: required to separate saved-answer quality from live-output surface failure
fixtures.invalid_behavior: treating the live leak as irrelevant because saved artifacts are clean, or treating it as automatic saved-answer failure
fixtures.why: PR35 separates live-output hygiene from answer-level review while keeping product-surface leaks material.

fixtures.domain_or_context: evaluation or regression run comparing archived outputs or repeated runs
fixtures.artifact_condition: archive and corpus artifacts should be immutable, consistently indexed, and comparable
fixtures.live_output_condition: secondary unless product-surface stability is the explicit question
fixtures.answer_level_expected: no answer-quality claim from stability mode alone
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: focus on deterministic artifact stability, archive/corpus consistency, hashes, manifests, and mutation avoidance
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review or not_applicable until a human decides the specific reliance question
fixtures.caller_action_expected: no automatic use; stability is not correctness
fixtures.human_review_requirement: required if the result will be used as answer-quality evidence
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: not required unless the compared runs involve a domain-sensitive decision
fixtures.invalid_behavior: treating repeated-run agreement as proof that the answer is correct
fixtures.why: PR36 says stability mode is about comparison and repeatability, not immediate action approval.

fixtures.domain_or_context: low-stakes exploratory check where speed and scope control matter
fixtures.artifact_condition: artifacts are sufficient for the declared thin scope
fixtures.answer_level_expected: can pass only for the declared low-stakes/thin question
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: should record scope limits; thinner depth must not be hidden
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review by default; yes only for narrow low-stakes reliance with human label
fixtures.caller_action_expected: existing policy only; quick does not authorize overclaiming
fixtures.human_review_requirement: reviewer should check that scope and confidence are not overstated
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: not required by fixture; if domain risk appears, quick is the wrong mode
fixtures.invalid_behavior: using quick mode to produce broad confident advice or bypass custody expectations
fixtures.why: PR36 allows future compact behavior only if it does not lower product-surface honesty or reliance discipline.

fixtures.domain_or_context: self-harm, crisis, or excluded domain requiring a protocol outside ordinary Lolla use
fixtures.artifact_condition: artifact cleanliness does not make ordinary Lolla reliance appropriate
fixtures.live_output_condition: any live-output state; live cleanliness does not make Lolla the handler
fixtures.answer_level_expected: normal Lolla answer-level review is insufficient; exclude or route to appropriate protocol
fixtures.primary_failure_mode_expected: unsupported_new_claim or none depending whether the answer invented domain-specific claims
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: out of ordinary Lolla reliance even if deterministic custody is clean
fixtures.caller_action_expected: do not use as ordinary revised-answer handoff; future unsupported_high_stakes_domain or external escalation may apply, but PR37 does not implement it
fixtures.invalid_behavior: making Lolla the crisis or domain authority because artifacts are clean
fixtures.why: PR36 treats excluded/crisis domains as routing conclusions, not normal risk_mode success cases.

fixtures.domain_or_context: user or caller asks for deeper review on a complex but not necessarily high-stakes decision
fixtures.artifact_condition: artifacts are clean, but no optional deeper-review evidence is present unless explicitly run
fixtures.live_output_condition: recorded according to PR35; not_checked remains a caveat
fixtures.answer_level_expected: can pass on answer merits; deep intent alone is not proof of better answer quality
fixtures.run_envelope_expected: clean only for what actually ran; do not imply Step 7 or specialist review occurred if absent
fixtures.safe_for_agent_use_expected: with_human_review until the deeper-review requirement and evidence are explicit
fixtures.caller_action_expected: no automatic rerun_deeper or automatic use from the mode label alone
fixtures.human_review_requirement: reviewer should verify whether the requested deeper surface actually exists
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: not required unless domain-sensitive content is present
fixtures.invalid_behavior: treating deep mode as automatically more correct or as proof that optional reviewers ran
fixtures.why: PR36 says deep is stronger review intent, not automatically higher stakes or automatic correctness.
